text:
alex: Heads-up — planning to fly in a day early for the Barcelona conf. Anyone have recs for hotels within a 10–15min walk of the venue?

tariq: Hotel Mercader was solid last year. small breakfasts but location is perfect. :thumbsup:

maria: If you want quieter, check Boutique Rambla 98 — more expensive but great street. also swaps into a good tapas area.

devon: PSA: if you can do carry-on only, short lines + no baggage fee drama. my carry-on fits in overhead on RyanAir like a champ 😂

jamie: Re: flights — red-eye sucks but you get a full day. take an aisle if you sleep weird. also bring a puffy hooded jacket as a pillow.

sophie: Anyone using the company travel stipend for upgrades? wondering if I should try for exit row.

alex: I used it last offsite to grab an exit row. quick note: you need to submit a receipt to expenses within 7 days. ops-bot can ping you the expense link.

ops-bot: Reminder: travel receipts must be uploaded to Expensely within 7 days to qualify for the stipend. :robot_face:

maria: Group dinner — should we do tapas crawl on Thursday or the big paella place on Friday? thumbs or votes please.

devon: Tapas crawl for me. easier for dietary stuff and people can filter in/out.

jamie: +1 tapas. easier to book multiple spots than a huge paella reservation.

sophie: tapas vote. also FYI: street parking is a headache near the venue, so if you’re driving consider hotel parking or a drop-off.

tariq: For transit to airport, Aerobus is cheap and reliable. or train if you want fewer stops. I usually do Aerobus and then Uber to hotel if late.

alex: Cool — tapas it is. I’ll start a shared google sheet with flight arrival times + hotel suggestions. drop your ETA and preferred check-in.

maria: Also, pack a small power strip. conference rooms always short on outlets. learned the hard way.

devon: tiny tip — screenshot your seat map save to phone; helps when checking at the gate.

jamie: Anyone doing luggage storage for the late checkout day? Some hotels charge; there’s a locker place 2 blocks from the venue. I can add link to the sheet.

alex: Perfect. thanks everyone — will share sheet and a quick poll for tapas spots tomorrow. :airplane:
